title: Purchase regrets and wished-for features
summary: This topic groups together praise for the car alongside wishes for different features or specifications, while many fragments are too brief or ambiguous to separate mild feature wishes from broader purchase regret.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car overall while mentioning wished-for improvements such as better sound, xDrive, or older infotainment features.

negative.summary: The negative review complains that automatic tailgate opening should be standard rather than an extra-cost option.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments express regret, second thoughts, or vague dissatisfaction such as wishing for another car, a larger engine, or having kept an older model, but the short excerpts do not provide enough context to classify them more precisely.

limitations: The topic mixes at least two related but distinct subjects: minor feature wishes within otherwise positive reviews and broader purchase-regret statements.
Many fragments are very short and lack surrounding context, which limits reliable separation between undetermined dissatisfaction and clearly negative sentiment.
The sample is sentiment-stratified and not representative, so it should not be used to infer how common these views are.
